thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error-rate (502/stream-stalls) for customer NorthStar Finance on their VPC Gateway (gw-nstar-prod). Auto-escalation to on-call. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vpc-gateway-streaming

erin (oncall): saw alerts, on it. paging sam + kumar. tagging acct rep julie to notify customer.

sam (plat): I'm up. quick summary?

erin (oncall): Gateway reports increased upstream 502s and WS stream stalls since ~2350012000. CPU/GPUs look fine on dedicated pool. Error pattern: client WS connects, receives initial events, then connection silent and eventually closed with 502 from app gateway.

kumar (runtime): getting packet capture now. hypothesis: idle timeouts / proxy-level retry storms causing connection reset. will attach tcpdump shortly.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2350012345. Severity: Sev2. Pager duty: erin acknowledged at 2350012350.

julie (acct): I'm on the thread and looping Ryan (sales) and NorthStar SRE. They report "streams disconnecting every ~20-40s" during peak. Customer is on dedicated VPC with custom app gateway in front.

sam (plat): can you share gateway config from their proxy? nginx/haproxy?

erin (oncall): fetched config from customer VPC (read-only): `proxy_read_timeout 30s; proxy_send_timeout 30s; keepalive_timeout 15s;`

kumar (runtime): that matches symptoms. WS/persistent streams with backend >30s idle will get reset. Also seeing retry loops from customer app causing bursts. grabbing logs:

```
[2026-03-15T12:07:02Z] gw-nstar-prod proxy: upstream returned 502, connection reset by peer
[2026-03-15T12:07:05Z] runtime: idle frame timeout: 30s, kvcache_keepalive expired
[2026-03-15T12:07:05Z] customer-app: reconnect attempt #1 after 80ms
[2026-03-15T12:07:25Z] gw-nstar-prod proxy: upstream returned 502
```

sam (plat): those reconnects line up with pocketed load. mitigation options: 1) increase proxy idle timeouts to 90s, 2) enable WS-level pings from gateway, 3) route NorthStar to a dedicated streaming-optimized pool with longer timeouts and separate ingress.

erin (oncall): what's lowest-risk immediate action?

kumar (runtime): lowest-risk: adjust gateway proxy timeouts in their VPC to 90s and enable `proxy_set_header Connection \"upgrade\"` / keepalive. we can push a change with config patch and quick reload. rollback if worse.

julie (acct): customer approval needed for config change? NorthStar SRE is online and ok with us applying a non-destructive timeout increase; they asked to be notified before any traffic reroute.

sam (plat): I'm going to patch the customer's gateway config now as a temporary mitigation. applying `proxy_read_timeout 90s; proxy_send_timeout 90s; keepalive_timeout 90s;` to their gw-nstar-prod config and doing a graceful reload.

erin (oncall): do it. I'll watch metrics and the stream logs. notify customer when complete.

sam (plat): patch pushed, starting graceful reload: `kubectl -n nstar-gw rollout restart deploy/gw-proxy`

incident-bot: Deploy job started by sam (plat). CI job id: ci-84392.

kumar (runtime): tcpdump before patch showed keepalive probes not present. after reload I'll capture again.

[~4m later]

erin (oncall): observing connection stability improving, downstream 502 rate dropped from 18% -> 2% over 5m. WS active sessions holding for >2min now.

julie (acct): letting NorthStar SRE know via email + phone: sent message: "We increased gateway timeouts as a temporary mitigation — monitoring. Will coordinate next steps."

ryan (sales): FYI customer execs are calling — they want ETA on permanent fix.

sam (plat): next steps proposal: 1) keep timeout change while we do full root cause, 2) provision a streaming-optimized dedicated pool (ns-stream-pool) with longer timeouts and KV cache tuned, 3) add a graceful backoff/ jitter to customer's client to avoid retry storms.

kumar (runtime): root cause analysis notes: older upstream app service sometimes doesn't emit frames for >30s during long-running inference; gateway proxied connection hits `proxy_read_timeout` and returns 502 -> client reconnect -> causes short spike. Suggest server-side keepalives or gateway WS pings to keep connection alive. Also add runtime metrics for `idle-frame-duration` and a trace id for these connections.

erin (oncall): are there tenant isolation concerns? could other tenants be affected when we route traffic or change timeouts?

\sam (plat): patch scoped to NorthStar's gw namespace only. No cross-tenant config. Routing to ns-stream-pool would be dedicated to NorthStar for streaming only to avoid impacting others.

julie (acct): customer asked for a postmortem and timeline. I'll coordinate with eng for mitigations and provide a customer-facing summary in 4 hours.

kumar (runtime): I'll open a follow-up ticket for runtime changes: enable WS ping/generator, increase default proxy timeouts for streaming customers, and add an auto-detect that flags long-inference idle windows. Ticket: RNW-4578.

erin (oncall): marking incident as mitigated at 2350012600. moving to monitoring. please add notes to incident doc.

sam (plat): leaving detailed command snippets for runbook:

```
# patch config (example)
kubectl -n nstar-gw patch configmap/gw-proxy-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"proxy_read_timeout":"90s","proxy_send_timeout":"90s","keepalive_timeout":"90s"}}'
# graceful reload
kubectl -n nstar-gw rollout restart deploy/gw-proxy
# capture tcpdump
kubectl -n nstar-gw exec -it deploy/gw-proxy -- tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/nstar-tcpdump.pcap 'tcp port 443 and host <customer-ip>'
```

incident-bot: Incident updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Mitigation tags: config-timeout-increase, isolated-dedicated-route-proposal.

erin (oncall): handoff to sam for follow-ups and postmortem. Sam, you own ticket RNW-4578 and the customer postmortem. I'll be available if escalation needed. :white_check_mark: 

sam (plat): acknowledged. I'll draft the postmortem and coordinate with Julie for customer messaging.

julie (acct): customer follow-up call scheduled in 90m. I'll share interim notes.

ryan (sales): please cc me on the customer summary. they want SLA credit options if this repeats.

erin (oncall): closing thread for active paging. If any regression, reopen with `!incident reopen` or re-pager. thanks all. :thumbsup:
